title: New External Link Reporting and Game Reward Limits
summary: The API now supports reporting for external content link transactions and introduces redemption limits for game-specific one-time product offers.
details: Developers participating in external link programs can now use the new `ExternalContentLinkDetails` object within `ExternalTransaction`. This includes fields for `linkType` (distinguishing between digital content offers and app downloads), `externalAppCategory` (APP or GAME), and `installedAppPackage`. Additionally, `OneTimeProductOffer` has been expanded with `OneTimeProductGameRewardOffer`, which allows setting a `redemptionLimit` between 1 and 50 for game-specific rewards.
